note: Single source of truth for a completed cloud round. Consumed by cloud_next/verify_cloud_artifacts.py and quoted in docs/CLOUD_RUNBOOK_2026-10-24.md. Paths are relative to the repository root (on the instance: the p3work checkout).

phase1.title: Decoder objective x scale ladder

artifacts.optional_reason: not run on 2026-10-24: the 3B weights are 7 GB and the data disk had ~14 GB free; the ladder ran 2B and 7B within the Qwen family instead. Run it when disk allows - it only adds an intermediate scale rung.

cross_checks: for every (model, seed) pair, frozen_dg_star must be identical between the contrastive and the generative run
meta.protocol must be 'match' for every rung of the ladder
meta.lora_arm must be 'both' and both adapter counts must be > 0

phase2.title: P3 environment-stack seeds
cross_checks: each rank has at least 4 distinct seeds on the torch26 stack (seed 42 plus the three new ones)
the aggregation lists which rows are single-seed, and no stack is reported as multi-seed unless it is

phase3.title: P3 VQA on the full test set
cross_checks: the reference-answer lists of the three arms must be byte-identical
the paired comparisons must be computed per question, not per arm mean

phase4.title: A23 multi-encoder transfer
cross_checks: every registered encoder has one cache per corpus and one row per corpus
the conclusion states whether any ordered pair beat chance by a margin surviving the paired bootstrap
